name: @pedroaugusto04/kote-mcp

tools.name: kote_search_notes
tools.description: Search notes and context in Kote memory database. ONLY call this tool if the user explicitly asks about historical design decisions, project onboarding, or reasoning not visible in the current code. DO NOT use this tool for syntax questions, local file searches, or standard library APIs.

query.description: The search query or keywords to find relevant notes

projectSlug.description: Optional project slug to restrict the search scope

tools.name: kote_get_note
tools.description: Get the full details and Markdown content of a specific Kote note by its unique ID. Only call this tool after finding a candidate note ID via "kote_search_notes".

id.description: The unique note ID retrieved from search results

tools.name: kote_create_note
tools.description: Save a new note, development decision, or context summary to Kote memory. Call this tool when you finish an important refactoring, resolve a complex bug, or agree with the user on an architectural choice, ensuring the decision is stored for future sessions.

markdown.description: Complete contents of the note in Markdown format

projectSlug.description: Optional project slug. Defaults to user configuration default project.
